clues.text: This prophet told King Ahaz that a virgin would give birth to a son and call Him Immanuel.
In the synagogue at Nazareth, Jesus was handed this prophet's scroll and read from it.
On the desert road toward Gaza, an Ethiopian court official sat in his chariot reading this prophet.
Matthew says John the Baptist was the voice in the wilderness this prophet spoke of.
He came to King Hezekiah, mortally ill, and told him to put his house in order.
When he called out to the LORD, the shadow went back ten steps on the stairway of Ahaz.
After Hezekiah showed his treasures to envoys from Babylon, this prophet warned it would all be carried off there.
